lede.zh: 同一份 Qwen3-8B BF16 权重在 Ascend 910B4 上接受固定长度、Agent 形状回放和 ShareGPT 负载测试。单卡测试覆盖 45 个合成测点；4 卡 TP4 测试覆盖 105 个 Agent 形状测点和 500 条 ShareGPT 提示词。
lede.en: The same Qwen3-8B BF16 checkpoint was measured on Ascend 910B4 with fixed-length requests, Agent-shaped replay, and ShareGPT traffic. The single-card study covered 45 synthetic points; the 4-card TP4 study covered 105 Agent-shaped points and 500 ShareGPT prompts.

snapshot.zh: 固定长度 · 多轮 Agent 形状 · ShareGPT 真实对话
snapshot.en: Fixed length · multi-turn Agent-shaped traffic · ShareGPT conversations

stats.zhNote: 7 种负载 × 5 并发 × 3 引擎

heading.zh: 工作负载不同，结论分别看

intro.zh: 单卡固定长度测试中，短/中输入的吞吐峰值由引擎实现与可用 KV 预算共同影响；长输入下 vLLM 与 MindIE 接近。4 卡 TP4 的 Agent 形状矩阵和 ShareGPT 回放中，vLLM 的高并发吞吐领先，但这属于特定软件版本和配置的观测。
intro.en: In the single-card fixed-length study, short and mid-input throughput reflects both engine implementation and available KV budget; vLLM and MindIE are close on long inputs. In the 4-card TP4 Agent-shaped and ShareGPT studies, vLLM leads high-concurrency throughput, within the tested software versions and configuration.

note.zh: 单卡 MindIE 的 KV 预算比另外两种引擎多约 15%；不把小于该差距的吞吐变化判作引擎胜负。三部分测试使用不同卡数、负载和工具，不能合并成一个排行榜。
note.en: Single-card MindIE had about 15% more KV budget than the other two engines; throughput differences within that band are not treated as engine wins. The three studies use different card counts, workloads, and tools and must not be combined into one ranking.

heading.zh: 短、中负载与长输入的吞吐排序不同
heading.en: Throughput ordering changes with prompt shape

intro.zh: 单卡 TP1，8K 上下文，三类固定输入/输出长度，每种形状并发 1/4/16/32/64。每个引擎与负载形状分别 sweep；C64 数字用于展示高压点。
intro.en: Single-card TP1, 8K context, and three fixed input/output shapes at concurrency 1/4/16/32/64. Each engine and shape was swept separately; C64 values show the high-load point.

title.zh: 单卡 C64 总输出吞吐
title.en: Single-card aggregate output throughput at C64

hint.zh: 固定输入 / 输出形状；MindIE 可用 KV 预算较高约 15%。
hint.en: Fixed input/output shapes; MindIE had about 15% more available KV budget.

notes.zh: MindIE 与 vLLM 在 Chat 的差距为 8%、Long 为 2%，均落入 KV 预算不对称范围；不据此宣布胜负。Long C64 的 TTFT 达数十秒，低延迟需求应看更低并发测点。
notes.en: MindIE differs from vLLM by 8% on Chat and 2% on Long, both within the KV-budget asymmetry; neither is treated as a decisive win. Long-shape C64 TTFT reaches tens of seconds, so latency-sensitive use should inspect lower-concurrency points.

heading.zh: Agent 负载放大了不同引擎的解码差距
heading.en: Agent-shaped traffic widens the decode-throughput gap

intro.zh: 4 卡 TP4，同一 BF16 权重，7 种固定形状 × 5 档并发 × 3 引擎，共 105 个测点。Agent-warm 模拟系统提示与工具说明前缀缓存；不执行真实工具动作。
intro.en: Four-card TP4 with the same BF16 checkpoint: seven fixed shapes × five concurrency levels × three engines, for 105 points. Agent-warm represents cached system/tool-description prefixes; it does not execute real tool actions.

title.zh: Agent 形状 · C32 请求速率
title.en: Request rate at C32 for Agent-shaped traffic

hint.zh: 每种负载形状独立测试，不能将各点视作同一请求长度曲线。
hint.en: Each workload shape is tested separately; points do not share one request-length profile.

notes.zh: 报告覆盖 chat/mid/agent/long 七类形状；表中列出核心点。vLLM 在 7/7 个形状的 RPS 领先，SGLang 的高并发 TPOT 较高。该结论只描述所测 2026 年 5 月版本，不代表当前版本表现。
notes.en: The source matrix covered seven chat/mid/Agent/long shapes; the table shows representative points. vLLM led RPS in all seven shapes, while SGLang had higher high-concurrency TPOT. This describes the May 2026 versions tested, not current releases.

heading.zh: 真实提示词回放保持了同一吞吐排序
heading.en: The real-prompt replay retained the same throughput ordering

intro.zh: 同一 4 卡 TP4 部署回放固定抽样的 500 条 ShareGPT V3 prompt，5 档并发。只比较此 ShareGPT 窗口，不与合成长度测试拼接。
intro.en: A fixed sample of 500 ShareGPT V3 prompts was replayed on the same 4-card TP4 setup at five concurrency levels. These results are specific to this ShareGPT window and are not pooled with synthetic-length tests.

hint.zh: 相同 500 条 prompt；固定抽样种子。
hint.en: Same 500 prompts with a fixed sample seed.

notes.zh: 真实数据集测试与固定长度合成测试的输入、输出分布不同；吞吐数字只在本报告的 ShareGPT 配置下成立。
notes.en: The real-dataset test has a different input/output distribution from fixed-length synthetic tests; throughput values apply only to this ShareGPT configuration.

methodIntro.zh: 报告合并三次同权重、同设备族的独立 benchmark 阶段。合成矩阵以固定长度请求测扩展；Agent 形状矩阵以缓存前缀和不同上下文长度模拟服务流量；ShareGPT 阶段使用真实公开对话提示词。
methodIntro.en: This report consolidates three benchmark phases using the same checkpoint and hardware family. The synthetic matrix uses fixed-length requests; the Agent-shaped matrix models cached prefixes and context lengths; the ShareGPT phase uses public conversational prompts.

methodNotes.zh: MindIE 单卡 KV 预算比其他引擎多约 15%，小幅吞吐差异不作胜负结论。各阶段硬件卡数、请求形状、请求量与客户端工具不同，结果不跨阶段直接排名。
methodNotes.en: MindIE had about 15% more KV budget in the single-card study, so small throughput differences are not treated as wins. Card count, request shape, request volume, and client tooling differ by phase; results are not ranked across phases.

methodNotes.zh: 早期报告将 910B4 的单卡 32 GB 测试与 4 卡 TP4 测试分开记录。机器名、服务地址、挂载路径等部署识别信息不纳入本报告。
methodNotes.en: The source studies recorded the 32 GB single-card and 4-card TP4 setups separately. Hostnames, service addresses, and mount paths are omitted.
